name: Politically Exposed Person Status 1 Code
definition: Status of a politically exposed person.

PE03.name: Close Associate
PE03.definition: Person known to be a close associate of the politically exposed person. A person known to be a close associate includes: |(a) a natural person who is known to have joint beneficial ownership of legal entities or legal arrangements, or any other close business relations, with the  politically exposed person,|(b) a natural person who has sole beneficial ownership of a legal entity or legal arrangement which is known to have been set up for the de facto benefit of a politically exposed person.

PE01.name: Natural Person Entrusted
PE01.definition: Natural person who is or who has been entrusted with prominent public functions.

PE02.name: Family Member
PE02.definition: Family member of the politically exposed person. A family member includes: |(a) the spouse, or a person considered to be equivalent to a spouse, of the politically exposed person,|(b) the children and their spouses, or persons considered to be equivalent to a spouse, of the politically exposed person,|(c) the parents of the politically exposed person.
